messages:
Marta (CS Ops): Heads-up — playbook-runner threw a bunch of exceptions during the 2am hygiene job. Not full outage but a spike in unhandled 'no-owner' cases.
Jamil (CS Eng): Ugh, saw alerts. Stack trace?
Marta (CS Ops): Pasted small excerpt from logs: `ERROR playbook_runner: failed to apply rule account_health_sweep: KeyError('owner_id')` repeated ~450x between 02:05-02:12.
Priya (Onboarding): Is this related to last week's contact import? We had that schema mismatch where owner could be null.
Alex (CSE): Likely. The playbook expects owner tags for routing. If owner is null the task queue tries and bails.
Jamil (CS Eng): Quick mitigation: I've pushed a guard to the runner to skip null owners and emit a metric. Rolling out to staging now. `git rev 3b7a9c2`
playbook-bot: Deploy started to staging (jamil/retry-null-owner-guard). CI: ✅  Tests: 12/12.
Marta (CS Ops): Thanks. We should also avoid auto-triggering the remediation nudge for those accounts — that causes noisy emails to customers.
Priya (Onboarding): Agree. We have a cohort of 120 new trial accounts that came in with missing owner metadata. Need to exclude them from healthscore-driven playbooks until owners are assigned.
Alex (CSE): Proposal: add a lightweight prefilter in playbook config: `filters: - owner_present: true` and a fallback mapping to mailbox `cs-unassigned@redwood.ai` for manual triage.
Jamil (CS Eng): I can add the filter flag and a toggle in admin UI. But for speed we can push a temporary rule in Redis: `playbook:filters:account_health_sweep = owner_present:true`
Marta (CS Ops): Can we also backfill owner mapping for accounts created in the last 7 days? We have some heuristics (territory -> owner). This will reduce the manual load.
Priya (Onboarding): I'll run the backfill script against a dry-run first and share results. Command I usually use: ```python tools/backfill_owners.py --since 7d --dry-run```
Alex (CSE): Also add a metric for 'playbook_skipped_no_owner' so we can monitor reduction after backfill.
playbook-bot: Reminder: scheduled daily hygiene job will run at 02:00 UTC. Next run in 22h.
Jamil (CS Eng): Timeline: push null-owner guard to prod in next 30m if staging looks good. Add Redis prefilter now (5m). Create an admin toggle and metric dashboard later this week.
Marta (CS Ops): I'll hold off escalation emails and patch the runbook: mark this as 'operational noise' not customer-impacting. Priya, once dry-run looks good, please give a thumbs and I'll approve backfill. :thumbsup:
Priya (Onboarding): Dry-run done — 114 matches, 92% high-confidence. I'll flip to live after lunch and post update here.
Alex (CSE): Great — once backfill completes, we'll re-enable the playbook remediations and close the alerts.
Marta (CS Ops): Thanks team. Post-mortem note: add a test case for null-owner in playbook runner unit tests.
Jamil (CS Eng): Adding test now. `tests/test_playbook_runner.py::test_skip_null_owner`
Priya (Onboarding): Update: backfill complete, owners assigned for 108 accounts, 6 flagged for manual review (bad data).
Marta (CS Ops): Closing thread for now. Will reopen if alerts reappear. :white_check_mark:
